params.message:
Verify reserves what it asks for, and counts CJK at a token a character

The fit check before classify-verify reserved 1,024 answer tokens while the
call sent the default max_tokens of 8,192, so a prompt within 7k tokens of
Llama's 131k context passed the check and Together refused it with 400
"Input validation error" (four times on 2026-10-05). The check and the call
now use the same number.

The estimate also counted four characters to a token for everything. Text
from the China adapters is close to one token per character, so a batch of
it read as a quarter of its size. CJK characters now count one each.
